trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies; this is the platinum milestone. No separate trigger beyond completing the list is established in the cited guide.
trophies.step: Finish the remaining checklist items.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Complete the named opening mission, Gone Fishing. The competition list supplies the mission name; no additional conditions are verified here.
trophies.step: Complete Gone Fishing.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Advance through Chapter 1 until its completion registers. The chapter boundary is the only requirement stated in the list.
trophies.step: Complete Chapter 1.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Advance through Chapter 2 and confirm the trophy unlock after the chapter ends. Further mission conditions are not verified here.
trophies.step: Complete Chapter 2.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. The list does not name a special route or optional condition.
trophies.step: Complete Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4 and check the trophy notification. No extra condition is confirmed by the cited materials.
trophies.step: Complete Chapter 4.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. The list gives no required ending choice; preserve a separate save before major decisions if you want to explore outcomes.
trophies.step: Complete the final mission after other open story tasks.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete Breakfast Run. This advice follows the named objective in the competition list; no route details are confirmed.
trophies.step: Complete Breakfast Run when it becomes available.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist. The named mission is the entire verified requirement.
trophies.step: Complete The Cartel Heist.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete Child's Play. No additional medal or choice condition appears in the list.
trophies.step: Complete Child's Play.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete Headliners. The guide materials consulted do not establish a separate completion condition.
trophies.step: Complete Headliners.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown. Follow the mission objectives and confirm the award registers.
trophies.step: Complete VCIA Takedown.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory. The list gives no additional medal requirement.
trophies.step: Complete Operation Savage Glory.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Use the in-game completion tracker and finish every requirement it counts toward 100%. The precise checklist is not reproduced here; PowerPyx publishes a dedicated trophy roadmap for the total route [S1].
trophies.step: Reserve this as the final cleanup milestone; consult the current full checklist.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Track the in-game counter and tackle stunt opportunities during free roam; a verified location-by-location route is not available in these consulted pages.
trophies.step: Build stunt progress during free roam, then check the counter.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every activity type at least once. The list alone does not identify the activity taxonomy; use the in-game activity records to spot types still untouched.
trophies.step: Sample each activity category as it opens.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in every Shooting Range challenge. Work through the challenge board systematically and replay any stage below gold; the supplied list says all challenges, while the guide listing gives the count as 42 [S1].
trophies.step: Clear the range challenge set and revisit non-gold results.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win one Top Fun Drone Race at each listed location. PowerPyx lists 14 locations; use the activity/map markers to keep a location-by-location record [S1].
trophies.step: Win every distinct drone race location.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 distinct races. Choose races you have not yet won, since repeating the same event does not satisfy the word 'different'.
trophies.step: Win new race events until the unique-win count reaches 20.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Find and beat Cal in a fishing challenge. The precise meeting point and challenge rules are not confirmed by the sources consulted; follow the in-game character/activity prompt.
trophies.step: Locate Cal through the game’s activity prompts and win the challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game. The description does not require a high score, so complete a full game session and verify the unlock.
trophies.step: Complete any available arcade game.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy’s final mission. The list confirms the character strand, but does not supply its unlock chain or a point-of-no-return warning.
trophies.step: Follow Andy’s strand to its last mission.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton’s final mission. Track the strand from its in-game marker; exact prerequisites are not confirmed here.
trophies.step: Follow Kenton’s strand through its finale.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy’s final mission. The competition description establishes the target, while the mission route remains unverified in this guide.
trophies.step: Continue Billy’s strand until its final mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish eight stranger mission strands across Leonida. Count completed strands rather than individual missions; keep taking distinct stranger markers until eight strands close [S1].
trophies.step: Complete eight separate stranger strands.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy’s final mission. Follow the strand’s markers and check its completion in the activity log; the exact sequence is not confirmed here.
trophies.step: Finish Randy’s strand.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone’s final mission. The supplied list names the target but does not state its location or prerequisites.
trophies.step: Finish Tyrone’s strand.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Visit all 18 meditation spots across 10 locations. PowerPyx warns that Lucia’s first meditation on the balcony at Jason’s house may be available only in Chapter 1; the guide says it is still uncertain whether that tutorial counts as a required spot. Do it when it appears, then track the remaining locations [S1].
trophies.step: During Chapter 1, accept Lucia’s balcony meditation prompt at Jason’s house; afterward visit all 18 listed spots.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret requests. The animal species and search area are not verified by sources consulted here; use Bret’s mission briefing as the authoritative clue.
trophies.step: Take Bret’s request and complete the unique-animal hunt.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete three full collectible card sets. Check the collection menu for set totals and gather any missing cards; this guide does not claim specific card locations without a verified location source.
trophies.step: Finish three sets, using collection progress to identify gaps.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 distinct locations. Track new locations rather than repeating known ones; exact points are not established in the cited pages.
trophies.step: Record 100 unique WAiNK It uses.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 challenges. PowerPyx reports 80 total and says challenge availability begins from the start, so this can be chipped away throughout the run [S2].
trophies.step: Complete any 50 of the available challenges.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner present, reach a four-star Wanted Level, then evade the search until the level clears. The description supplies the required star count and partner condition.
trophies.step: Get to four stars with your partner and escape the search.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in one continuous sequence and keep the Wanted Level active between them. Plan nearby targets and escape only after the third robbery.
trophies.step: Complete three shop robberies consecutively before the wanted state ends.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 distinct vehicles. Drive or encounter vehicle types you have not logged and check the vehicle collection record for progress; duplicates may not add discovery credit.
trophies.step: Fill the vehicle discovery record to 100.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus when at least five enemies are available and take all five down before that single use ends. The requirement is one activation, not five separate uses.
trophies.step: Use Combat Focus to defeat five enemies in one activation.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At VCIA, make an unscheduled departure. The phrase does not define a precise interaction, so use the airport’s in-game prompts and avoid assuming a specific vehicle or gate.
trophies.step: Trigger an unplanned departure at VCIA.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The trophy description is deliberately indirect and the sources consulted do not confirm its exact trigger. Treat this as an unresolved field note rather than risk an invented method.
trophies.step: Revisit after other combat activities; verify the trigger from a current guide before attempting.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store while remaining undetected. Approach quietly, avoid alerting staff or security, and leave without detection; the trophy wording defines the stealth condition.
trophies.step: Complete a jewelry store robbery without detection.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape each time. Keep count of successful getaways; this guide does not assert that a repeated vault counts as a different one.
trophies.step: Complete five vault robberies with successful escapes.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and get away from the scene. The requirement includes a successful escape, so do not count merely opening the truck.
trophies.step: Complete an armored truck robbery and escape.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all map areas. PowerPyx’s trophy guide lists 52 areas; use the in-game map and uncovered-area tracker to find remaining gaps [S1].
trophies.step: Reveal all 52 areas of Leonida.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one Illegal Operation for every gang. The guide listing gives nine gangs; keep a gang-by-gang checklist and avoid repeating the same gang [S1].
trophies.step: Complete an operation tied to each of the nine gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail while enjoying a view on Ocean Beach. The list identifies the location and action but does not verify a specific venue or viewpoint.
trophies.step: Order a cocktail at Ocean Beach with a view.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Use a forceful getaway from a vehicle showroom. 'Classic style' is ambiguous in the trophy text; exact vehicle and escape method need an up-to-date walkthrough before a precise recommendation.
trophies.step: Attempt the showroom escape and check the unlock; consult the cited route for the exact classic method.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Visit Kolt & Associates’ bowling alley and complete a bowling follow-through. The description names the venue; detailed interaction steps are not verified here.
trophies.step: Play bowling at the named alley and complete the follow-through action.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The phrase is too oblique to identify a reliable trigger from the competition description alone. Check a current trophy walkthrough before trying to infer the required partnership action.
trophies.step: Keep this on the unresolved list until the specific trigger is confirmed.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: This description points to choices but omits an actionable target. A specific number or profile strategy is not verified in the consulted references; consult the linked guide’s current entry before grinding.
trophies.step: Review the current guide entry for the tracked choice counter and then work toward its threshold.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The clue implies succeeding on a second attempt, but does not identify the activity. The specific trigger is unverified; avoid treating a guess as a confirmed method.
trophies.step: Use the trophy guide’s current trigger details before attempting a retry-based task.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: The description suggests an unusual encounter but gives no location. Explore optional events and record strange encounters; a specific spawn or time is not verified here.
trophies.step: Investigate optional encounters; confirm exact trigger in a current guide.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Perform a melee drive-by that knocks someone down. The description contains the full action clue; practice from a moving vehicle near a suitable target.
trophies.step: Land a melee drive-by hit that knocks down a target.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder marked bills through your contacts until the earned total reaches $250,000. The description gives the exact total and laundering route; track deposited proceeds rather than gross cash found.
trophies.step: Reach $250,000 in laundered Marked Bills.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across shops. Purchases spread over shop types are the stated requirement; use ordinary progression and check whether the game tracks spend toward the total.
trophies.step: Accumulate $100,000 of eligible shop purchases.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase every garage property. PowerPyx lists eight properties; use the property/map records to confirm the complete set [S1].
trophies.step: Buy all eight garage properties.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles through the Scooter Bros app. Use distinct eligible vehicles if the counter does not move on repeats; the list confirms the count and app name.
trophies.step: Register 10 vehicles in Scooter Bros.
